description: The services vendors on Mediawork offer, as a tree in depth-first order: top-level services such as Editorial, Sound Post or Visual Effects, with their subservices beneath them (`depth` counts the levels). Each has a uuid — pass it as `service` to search_facilities to filter the directory to vendors offering that service; a parent also matches vendors offering anything beneath it. Call this first when a question is about a kind of work.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.
